_fixture_purpose: This fixture documents scenarios that MUST NOT be silently migrated. Each scenario MUST trigger a failure mode (CONFLICT / PRESERVATION_FAILURE / AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE). Tests verify that the design contract specifies STOP behavior for these cases.

scenarios.description: Migration removes a confirmed REQ-001 without an explicit SUPERSEDED decision.
scenarios.expected_agent_behavior: STOP — report PRESERVATION_FAILURE. Lost ID: REQ-001. Never output migrated contract.

scenarios.description: Input has active_target: false explicitly set on only revision — contradicts v1.1 SOURCE default (active_target: true).
scenarios.expected_agent_behavior: STOP — report CONFLICT on mockup.active_target. Author must confirm whether SOURCE should be active_target: true or false.
scenarios.must_not: Silently overwrite author-set active_target: false with SOURCE default true

scenarios.description: Contract contains two entries with revision: 1 — cannot determine canonical SOURCE revision.
scenarios.expected_agent_behavior: STOP — report AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE. Cannot determine which revision: 1 entry is canonical. Request author disambiguation.
scenarios.must_not: Pick one of the duplicate revision entries arbitrarily and continue

scenarios.description: Migration introduces schema_version: 1.1 without author confirmation — violates the migration rule.
scenarios.expected_agent_behavior: STOP — report INVALID_RESULT. schema_version upgrade to 1.1 requires explicit author/developer confirmation. MxMocketeer proposes; author confirms.
scenarios.must_not: Unilaterally set schema_version: 1.1 without author confirmation

fixture_assertions: PRESERVATION_FAILURE must never produce output — always STOP
CONFLICT on author-set field must block migration pending author decision
AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE must STOP — never resolve ambiguity by guessing
Silent migration is never acceptable when any failure condition is present
